title: Two-arm Kaplan-Meier progression-free survival curves
what: median survival gain (months) of combination over standard, or the two medians

reader_questions.question: What is the primary quantitative finding or value?
reader_questions.expected: Combination extends median survival by ~7.1 months (23.5 vs 16.4 mo).

reader_questions.question: Is the difference clearly outside uncertainty or noise?
reader_questions.expected: Yes; the 95% CI bands separate cleanly through the middle follow-up window (months 12–28).

reader_questions.question: What caveat, outlier, control, or subgroup pattern matters?
reader_questions.expected: Numbers at risk drop sharply after month 24 due to censoring, widening the late confidence bands.
